data.title: Allow Claude to mark bugs done automatically
data.body:
## Goal

Let Claude mark bugs as done when all acceptance criteria are complete.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `docket done ID --auto` transitions to Done if all criteria checked
- [ ] Parse body for `- [x]` and `- [ ]` checkboxes
- [ ] Only succeed if ALL checkboxes are checked
- [ ] Fail with clear message if unchecked criteria remain
- [ ] Consider: `--force` flag to override the check
- [ ] Update `/docket-implement` skill to use this when appropriate

## Context

Currently Claude must ask the user or make a judgment call about when work is complete. If acceptance criteria are well-defined, we can automate this: when all `- [ ]` become `- [x]`, the bug is done.

This creates a nice feedback loop: clear criteria → automated completion detection.
